evidence_status: Saved development decision; no new visual inspection, rendering or scoring. Historical task interpretation is the object of review.

request.text: Transform the basketball game video into a high-budget cinematic Wuxia movie scene. The two players are now wearing elegant, flowing ancient Chinese Hanfu robes with wide sleeves. The basketball court is replaced by an ancient, weathered stone training platform located high in the misty mountains, surrounded by a dense bamboo forest and traditional wooden pagodas. Add dramatic golden hour sunlight filtering through the leaves, creating long shadows and atmospheric haze.

source.timing_basis: decoder frame index and reported FPS; sampled observations, not a continuous-motion verification

arguments.prompt:
Transform this entire shot into a photorealistic, high-budget historical Wuxia film scene. Preserve the two original players, their faces, positions, footwork, timing and basketball interaction: the left player dribbles, advances and takes the jump shot while the other player defends and watches the ball. Keep one basketball following its original hand contacts, bounces, release and airborne trajectory. Preserve the continuous wide shot and original camera movement.

Dress the left player in elegant ivory Hanfu with layered flowing skirts, a muted gold sash and soft cloth boots; dress the defender in deep charcoal and dark teal Hanfu with a fabric sash and cloth boots. Both have broad, flowing ancient Chinese sleeves. The sleeve fabric hangs beneath and behind the active forearms, with open cuffs exposing the hands so the dribbling and shot remain visible. Robe hems and sleeves ripple naturally with each step and jump.

Completely replace the indoor gym with an outdoor training terrace high in misty Chinese mountains. The entire floor becomes large weathered gray stone slabs with worn joints and subtle moss along the outer edges; remove painted court markings and the red floor. Replace the mural walls with dense bamboo groves, traditional timber pagodas with tiled upturned roofs, and distant layered mountain peaks visible through gaps. Replace the ceiling, lamps and steel beams with open sky and overhead bamboo leaves. Reinterpret the existing main basketball support as an aged timber training frame carrying a simple circular hoop and hanging rope net at the original target position. Remove modern backboards, signage, logos, air conditioners and gym equipment.

Low golden-hour sunlight filters through bamboo from the upper left, casting long directional shadows across the stone. Warm rim light outlines the robes; soft mountain mist creates cool atmospheric depth behind the players. Rich natural textures, restrained cinematic color, luminous haze and realistic anatomy, with the action remaining clear throughout.

request.note: The transformation preserves the basketball event while placing the Wuxia design in costumes, terrain, architecture and light. Wide sleeves drape behind the working hands to support the requested silhouette and readable ball contact.
